title: STI-Alabang 360: A Web-Based Integrated Intelligence System for Student Lifecycle Management and Career Success
description: A campus management portal that connects every department in one dashboard for the full student lifecycle, from admissions to career success.

caseStudy.problem: Campus departments each handled their part of the student lifecycle separately. STI-360 brings admissions, guidance, front desk, marketing and student services into one portal.

features.title: Architecture & team leadership
features.description: Set the system architecture, database design and coding standards; coordinate tasks, code reviews and version control on GitHub.

features.title: Role-based dashboards
features.description: Separate dashboards for Superuser, Admin, Front Desk, Guidance, Marketing, Students and exam takers.

features.title: Online exam portal
features.description: A dedicated login and dashboard for applicants taking the entrance exam.

features.title: Assessment analysis
features.description: Server-side analysis of assessment results through a Supabase Edge Function.

features.title: Records archive
features.description: An archive vault for keeping older records out of the active system.

outcomes: Led a team of 5 developers from architecture through deployment; live at sti-360.vercel.app.
Brought 4 departments into one portal with 7 role-based dashboards: Superuser, Admin, Front Desk, Guidance, Marketing, Student and Exam Taker.
